metric: Freight and logistics emissions per race weekend, even split across the 2025 calendar

derivation.formula: 2025 freight and logistics emissions / 24 Grand Prix rounds
assumptions: AMF1 publishes annual totals only; per-race freight is not disclosed.
An even split ignores distance: fly-away rounds such as Singapore very likely carry more than European rounds reached by road.
The annual figure also includes non-race logistics (supplier deliveries), so this is an upper bound for race freight alone.

assumptions: Business travel also covers non-race trips (events, supplier visits), so this overstates race travel.
